title: HireSight
subtitle: Visual Analytics for Tech Job Search
description: Deployed analytics product for tracking and improving tech job search outcomes.
outcome: Resume parsing, role-fit guidance, Sankey flows, heatmaps, and trend views.
bullets: LLM-powered recommendation engine for uploaded resume PDFs.
React frontend, FastAPI backend, Vercel and Render deployment.

title: News Recommendation Atlas
subtitle: Cold-Start Signal Study
description: Recommendation experiment on MIND-small for cold-start user ranking.
outcome: +13.8% MRR and +11.5% NDCG@10 for content signals on cold-start users.
bullets: Combined FP-Growth, co-click graphs, TF-IDF, LDA, and logistic regression.
Evaluated 50K users and 156K impressions with reproducible metrics.

title: Cache Replacement Policy
subtitle: PACIPV + RL-Based Study
description: Cache replacement research using simulation and workload benchmarking.
outcome: Compared miss-rate and IPC tradeoffs across workload patterns.
bullets: Evaluated on SPEC CPU2006 and PARSEC benchmark suites across varying cache configurations.
Analyzed miss rate reduction, IPC improvements, and policy tradeoffs under different workload patterns.

title: CUDA Cholesky Factorization
subtitle: ~76x GPU Speedup
description: GPU implementation of dense linear algebra factorization.
outcome: Achieved approximately 76x speedup over a sequential CPU baseline.
bullets: Leveraged tiled matrix operations, shared memory, and optimized thread block configurations.
Benchmarked across matrix sizes demonstrating superlinear GPU acceleration for dense linear algebra.
